records.old: PART A — CONE NET INVESTIGATION (30 min): Each group of 4 receives a pre-cut cone net (a circle and a sector of a larger circle) and a complete cone model. Groups are guided through the following steps: (1) Identify the two components of the cone's surface — the circular base (radius r) and the curved lateral surface (sector). (2) Measure the slant height l (the radius of the sector) using a ruler. (3) Notice that the arc length of the sector equals the circumference of the base circle (2πr). (4) Using the formula for the area of a sector (Area = ½ × arc length × radius), derive that Lateral Surface Area = ½ × 2πr × l = πrl. (5) Write the total surface area: SA = πrl + πr² = πr(r + l). Groups record each step in a structured observation table provided on a worksheet. PART B — SPHERE INTUITION ACTIVITY (15 min)
